steps.title: Prepare HMI‑9 cell culture medium
steps.instruction: Dissolve 17.7 g IMDM, 3 g sodium bicarbonate, 10 mL hypoxanthine (10 mM), 10 mL sodium pyruvate (100 mM), 28.2 mg bathocuproine sulfonate (49.95 µM), 182 mg L‑cysteine·HCl (1.04 mM) and 14 µL 2‑mercaptoethanol (14 M) in 500 mL Milli‑Q water, bring volume to 900 mL, filter through a 0.22 µm PES filter, add 100 U sterile penicillin and 100 µg/mL streptomycin (optional), finish with 10 % heat‑inactivated FBS, store at 4 °C (shelf‑life 4 months).

steps.title: Prepare drug‑selectable marker stocks
steps.instruction: Make 20 mg/mL G418 (1 g in 50 mL water), 5 mg/mL tetracycline (0.5 g in 10 mL water), and 1 mg/mL phleomycin (0.05 g in 50 mL water); filter each solution through a 0.22 µm syringe filter, aliquot 1 mL into 1.5 mL tubes, store at –20 °C (stable ≥1 year).

steps.title: Prepare PBS‑G buffer (1 L)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1.42 g Na₂HPO₄ (0.01 M), 1.20 g NaH₂PO₄ (0.01 M), 8.5 g NaCl (0.145 M) and 1.081 g D‑glucose (0.006 M) in 900 mL Milli‑Q water, adjust pH to 7.0, filter‑sterilize (0.22 µm), bring to 1 L, store at 4 °C (stable 3 months).

steps.title: Prepare bloodstream stabilate freezing solution (500 mL)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 9.3 g D‑glucose (0.052 M), 2.1 g NaCl (0.036 M), 0.75 g sodium citrate (0.003 M), 0.5 g BSA and 75 g glycerol in 300 mL water, add glycerol‑equivalent volume (75 g) separately, adjust final volume to 500 mL, filter (0.22 µm), store at 4 °C (stable 6 months).

steps.title: Prepare 50× TAE solution (500 mL)
steps.instruction: Make 0.5 M EDTA by dissolving 18.6 g EDTA‑Na₂ in 80 mL water, adjust pH to 8.0 with 10 M NaOH, bring to 100 mL; dissolve 121 g Tris base in 300 mL water, add 28.6 mL 17.4 M glacial acetic acid and 50 mL 0.5 M EDTA, bring to 500 mL, autoclave, store at room temperature (stable ≥6 months).

steps.title: Prepare 80 % ethanol solution
steps.instruction: Mix 80 mL 100 % ethyl alcohol (v/v) with 20 mL Milli‑Q water in a 100 mL graduated cylinder, store at 4 °C (stable 1 month).

steps.title: Induce PIP5Pase knockdown in culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL T. brucei (427 or CN) at 1 × 10⁴ cells/mL in HMI‑9 + 2 µg/mL G418, 2.5 µg/mL phleomycin, 500 ng/mL tetracycline; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 24 h (or until ~1 × 10⁶ cells/mL, doubling time 5.5–6 h, viability 90‑95 %).

steps.title: Wash cells to remove tetracycline
steps.instruction: Transfer culture to a 15 mL Falcon tube, centrifuge 3,500 × g, 5 min, RT; discard supernatant; resuspend pellet in 10 mL PBS‑G pre‑warmed to 37 °C, centrifuge as before; repeat wash three times total.

steps.title: Set up treated and control flasks
steps.instruction: Split washed cells into two 5 mL flasks (treated and non‑treated) at 1 × 10⁴ cells/mL in HMI‑9 + 2 µg/mL G418, 2.5 µg/mL phleomycin; add 500 ng/mL tetracycline to the non‑treated (Tet +, control) only; incubate 24 h; then add 500 ng/mL tetracycline to the treated flask (Tet –, knockdown). No further tetracycline is added to the control.

steps.title: Determine cell concentration and viability
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL culture with 10 µL 0.4 % Trypan Blue, load 10 µL into CellDrop™ counter; expect ~1 × 10⁵ cells/mL and >90 % viability.

steps.title: Prepare dilution series for cloning
steps.instruction: Add 9 mL HMI‑9 + 500 ng/mL tetracycline to a 50 mL Falcon tube (for each group, three tubes total); from the 1 × 10⁵ cells/mL culture transfer 1 mL into tube 1 (1 × 10⁴ cells/mL), then 1 mL from tube 1 into tube 2 (1 × 10³ cells/mL), and 1 mL from tube 2 into tube 3 (1 × 10² cells/mL). Perform the same for control and treated groups.

steps.title: Seed flasks for low‑density cultures
steps.instruction: Transfer 7 mL from tube 3 into a 75 cm² flask containing 63 mL HMI‑9 + 2 µg/mL G418, 2.5 µg/mL phleomycin, 500 ng/mL tetracycline (final 10 cells/mL). Transfer 60 mL from tube 3 into another 75 cm² flask with 140 mL HMI‑9 + same supplements (final 3 cells/mL).

steps.title: Plate single‑cell clones in 96‑well plates
steps.instruction: Aliquot 200 µL of the 3 cells/mL culture into each well of ten 96‑well plates per treatment (using a multichannel pipette, gently swirl cultures while pipetting); this yields ~30 % wells containing a single parasite clone. Incubate 5–7 days at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, monitor under a microscope (check days 5‑7).

steps.title: Expand clones in 24‑well plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of each identified clone into a 24‑well TC plate, add 1.8 mL fresh HMI‑9 + 2 µg/mL G418, 2.5 µg/mL phleomycin, 500 ng/mL tetracycline; incubate 24 h to increase cell numbers for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Optional: Freeze clonal populations
steps.instruction: Aliquot 600 µL of each clone into a 96‑well deep‑collection plate, add 600 µL bloodstream stabilate freezing solution, freeze at –80 °C (2–3 weeks) or liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage; retain the remaining 1.4 mL for RNA extraction.

steps.title: RNA extraction from clonal cultures
steps.instruction: Transfer 1.4 mL of each clone (~1.4 × 10⁶ cells) to a 96‑well deep‑collection plate, centrifuge 3,500 × g, 5 min, RT, discard supernatant; add 350 µL Buffer Rlysis‑BG, pipette up/down 5×, seal, invert 3×, spin 1,000 × g, 30 s, RT; add 175 µL absolute ethanol, reseal, invert 5×; load lysate onto EZ‑10 96‑well filtration plate placed over a fresh deep‑well plate, centrifuge 5,000 × g, 2 min, RT, discard flowthrough; add 500 µL universal GT solution, centrifuge 5,000 × g, 1 min, discard flowthrough; add 500 µL universal NT solution, centrifuge 5,000 × g, 1 min, discard flowthrough; centrifuge 5,000 × g, 2 min to remove residual ethanol; place EZ‑10 plate on a new deep‑well plate, add 30 µL RNase‑free water, incubate RT 5 min, centrifuge 5,000 × g, 1 min, RT to elute RNA; quantify 1 µL of each eluate at 260 nm on a NanoDrop (≈10 random wells) and keep plates sealed on ice or at –80 °C until cDNA synthesis.

steps.title: cDNA synthesis and clonal barcoding
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 µM primer mix (forward Ad‑SL and reverse Ad‑3endVSG) in a 96‑well plate; add 4 µL primer mix and 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs to each well of a new 96‑well PCR plate; thaw RNA samples on ice, add 5 µL RNA to corresponding wells, pipette up/down 5×, spin 1,000 × g, 30 s, 4 °C; incubate plate 65 °C, 5 min, then place on ice; prepare cDNA master mix per reaction: 2 µL 10× MuLV buffer, 5 U M‑MuLV Reverse Transcriptase, 8 U RNase inhibitor, water to 10 µL; add 10 µL master mix to each well, seal, spin 1,000 × g, 30 s, incubate 42 °C, 2 h, then 65 °C, 20 min; store cDNA at –80 °C or proceed.

steps.title: Barcoding PCR of pooled cDNA
steps.instruction: Pool all cDNA (step C8) into one 1.5 mL tube, mix gently 5×; set up 10 PCR reactions each containing 5 µL 10× ThermoPol buffer, 400 µM dNTPs, 500 nM Native Barcoding Expansion 1‑12 primer mix, 2 U Taq DNA Polymerase, 750 nM MgCl₂, 3 µL pooled cDNA, water to 50 µL; thermocycle 95 °C 10 min; 22 cycles of 95 °C 1 min, 62 °C 1 min, 68 °C 3:30 min; final extension 68 °C 10 min.

steps.title: Clean up pooled PCR amplicons
steps.instruction: Combine all PCR products into one tube (final volume 500 µL); add 350 µL (0.65×) NucleoMag NGS beads, rotate 60 rpm, 10 min, RT; spin 1,000 × g, 30 s, place on magnetic rack 1 min, discard supernatant; wash beads twice with 350 µL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol (volume equals total PCR + beads, e.g., 850 µL), each wash 1 min on magnet; spin 1,000 × g, 30 s, RT, remove residual ethanol, air‑dry beads 10 min (avoid >30 min); resuspend beads in 61 µL nuclease‑free water, flick or pipette 5×, incubate RT 5 min; place on magnet 1 min, transfer 61 µL eluate to a new tube, discard beads; quantify 1 µL on NanoDrop (expected 30‑60 ng/µL, 260/280 ≈1.8, 260/230 ≈2.0).

steps.title: DNA repair and end‑prep
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL PCR tube combine 1 µg DNA (≈47 µL water) with 3.5 µL NEBNext FFPE DNA repair buffer, 2 µL FFPE DNA repair mix, 3.5 µL Ultra II End‑prep buffer, 3 µL Ultra II End‑prep enzyme mix, 1 µL DNA CS; mix gently 5×, incubate 60 min at 20 °C; add 39 µL NucleoMag NGS beads (0.65×), perform bead cleanup as in steps D5‑D13, elute in 61 µL water, quantify 1 µL (≈90 % recovery).

steps.title: Adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Transfer 60 µL end‑repaired DNA (0.5‑1 µg) to a 0.2 mL tube, add 25 µL Ligation Buffer (LNB), 10 µL NEBNext Quick T4 DNA Ligase, 5 µL Adapter Mix F (AMX‑F); mix 5×, brief spin, incubate 2 h at 20 °C.

steps.title: Final library clean‑up
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL AMPure XP beads (0.4×) to ligation reaction, rotate 60 rpm, 10 min, RT; spin 1,000 × g, 30 s, magnet 1 min, discard supernatant; wash beads twice with 250 µL Short Fragment Buffer (SFB) as in steps D25‑D26, spin, magnet, discard; air‑dry beads 10 min (do not over‑dry); resuspend beads in 12 µL Oxford Nanopore Elution Buffer (EB), pipette 5×, brief spin, incubate RT 10 min; magnet 1 min, transfer eluate (library) to a new tube, discard beads; quantify 1 µL on NanoDrop (expected 10‑40 ng/µL, 200‑1,500 fmol).

steps.title: Load library onto Flongle flow cell and sequence
steps.instruction: Load 3‑20 fmol of the prepared library onto an R9.4.1 Flongle flow cell and run sequencing according to Oxford Nanopore Technologies’ instructions.
